cost.denominator: First-request-triggered complete history rebuild once per user per release, plus native service, minus matched Reuse native service.
cost.state_accounting: Conservative: encode every resident history at each release and every native append. No savings from causal retirement assumed in population ledger.
cost.projection_scope: Same model, three-release horizon and per-resident real-event mix. Fixed calibration population. Extrapolated FLOPs only, not measured quality or service.
cost.causal_row_policy: Zero Value codes only where the existing per-layer causal support is false; all release-time rows are initially inherited. Native writes, fitting and decoder weights are unchanged. Causal-native is not a lazy-Full equality claim.
cost.causal_zero_write_scope: Boolean selection and writing zeros add bytes, not arithmetic FLOPs. The bound assumes every appended code is zeroed; release-time masks are all true. Actual zero-write bytes are retained in each development user's correction_costs. No encoding FLOP savings or loaded-serving latency improvement is claimed.

notes: Scoring accepts no labels; labels and frozen reference scores are attached after inference.
Native K/V writes are unchanged and the trajectory is not reset across releases.
The cost denominator and fixed calibration do not shrink when --max-users is used.
Small-sample recovery is a development signal, not acceptance or final generalization.
